clips.title: The story
paras: At Anvilmar, Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery carries news to scouts beyond the frozen lake. Snow and nearby troggs can leave the valley's defenders cut off, so correspondence keeps them connected.

In Coldridge Valley, news from the rest of Dun Morogh reaches Anvilmar by mountain pass. Winter couriers bring the mail, and the letters soon gather in the hall. Sten Stoutarm manages supplies and security, so he depends on recruits to carry the bundles down the western road. Without them, important messages would remain at Anvilmar.

Talin Keeneye watches the frozen lake to the west, keeping an eye on trogg movements and dangerous wildlife. Even at a cold outpost, news from Ironforge and the surrounding camps matters. The mountain conditions make sorting mail difficult, and letters for different scouts can end up together in one bundle.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hm, I don't suppose you'd be willing to do a favor for me, friend? A stack of letters came through the pass today, but I don't have the time to send them along.
They're all addressed to Talin Keeneye. You can find him to the west down the road. He's set up camp next to the frozen lake.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes? Do you have something for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, I've been waiting for these letters for quite some time...
Unfortunately, these letters aren't all for me. This one is addressed to Grelin Whitebeard. He's not too far away if you'd like to deliver it to him.
